mission.title: Irresistible
mission.description: Secure the listening post and sound out Zion's representative at the meeting.

phase.briefing:
Ah, my plan is coming together, {player}. Aren't you happy for me? The trap is about to spring, and the delightful thing is that they won't even realize it until it's far too late; not that they have any alternative to walking into it, anyway. Oh, such genius! It really deserves better than to be wasted on Zionites, but, when in Rome...
Are you still standing there? Didn't I tell you that I need you to secure our listening post near the meeting area? Get moving!

enter.say: The listening post is in that building. I'm picking up some redpills inside--not ours, either.

Those idiots must be some of Anome's supporters. Apparently his following among Niobe's old faithful was larger than we expected... No doubt he's lured them away with promises of vast power from the Machines' "cheat codes."

done.say: That's takes care of all of the signals in the area. Stupid buggers, working for Anome like that. A fool and his RSI are soon parted...
Good, looks like they didn't figure out how to mess with the scanning equipment.

phase.briefing:
Anome's followers... What a joke. It is to laugh.
The meeting is coming up shortly. Too bad you'll be missing it! I'll be happy to give you all the juicy details later, though.
Oh, Malphas wants to see you for some reason; I can't imagine what.

enter.say: Malphas is in there. Have you seen that guy's skin? Eesh.

talk.say:
I understand you've been handling security for these meetings recently. I would like you to appear at the impending meeting with Zion, at a specific time. I wish to sound out their representative, Ghost, without appearing too curious about him myself. I want to know how confident he is in Zion's survival should Niobe perish.
Flood will signal you when your presence is required.

done.say: Wait, didn't Flood just say you weren't going to be at the meeting?

phase.briefing:
{player}... It... It seems that you will be at the meeting after all, while I...oversee things from my control area.
That's the way I prefer it, anyway. Meetings are so dull. I'm sure you'll be bored to tears.
Run along to the meeting now.

enter.say: Two programs and one redpill in there. That should be the Merovingian, Malphas, and Ghost. There was another Zion operative, but they left just a minute ago.

talk.say: It's about time you got here. Your Zionite counterpart has already come and gone.

done.say: I see. Always rooting about for an advantage, eh, Malphas? Haha! Don't think I don't know you well, you sly devil.

talk.say: We're going to get Niobe back. And Zion is more than any one person. If you'd spent more time there, maybe you would have found that out.

done.say: Was that what Malphas was looking for? Better check with him.

talk.say: Good work. He maintains a defiant facade, but I can smell the worry on him. Delightful.

done.say: All right, sounds like he's happy. You're all done in there.

phase.briefing:
Aha! I told you it would be a boring meeting, didn't I? Thank goodness it occurred to me to send you in my place. Yes...
Before you got there, the Merovingian told Ghost that we'd save his precious Niobe for free. Hah! You should have seen Ghost try to figure out what to make of that. It was genius, I tell you. So glad I thought of it.
The Merovingian wants to see you now, for some reason. Try not to waste his time, would you?

enter.say: The Merovingian is in there. I wonder what he wants?

talk.say:
Cause and effect: I make a generous offer, and it is accepted. We left Zion no choice, you see?
Since you will be involved in the rescue operation, I wished to impress upon you that no harm is to come to Niobe at our hands. We will return her to her caves safe and sound, and Zion will find that it no longer has an excuse for making war on us.

done.say: Ohh! So once we rescue Niobe, she'll be obligated to call off her little war against us. Man, they're gonna be eatin' crow down in Zion for months!

You understand now. You see, you must know when to give, and when to take. I take their Morpheus, I give their Niobe. Ah, I must look like a veritable demigod to those simpletons. They are mine to manipulate as I see fit.

mission.finish: What did he talk to you about? Was it about the success of my plan? It was, wasn't it? {player}?
